major_cooldowns.name: Dragonrage
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown roughly every 2 minutes with Tip the Scales, Eternity Surge, Fire Breath, and your damage potion ready so the window opens with every cooldown chained; press Eternity Surge and Fire Breath inside it to extend the buff via Animosity.

major_cooldowns.name: Eternity Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Empower at Rank 1 in single target and most AoE, cast on cooldown and prioritized inside Dragonrage to extend the buff; use Tip the Scales on it for an instant max-rank cast during the burst window.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Empower at Rank 1 and keep the damage-over-time debuff applied, refreshing only when it has 30% or less duration remaining; it has two charges so weave both in and around Dragonrage to feed Consume Flame explosions.

major_cooldowns.name: Deep Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Scalecommander use on cooldown (including just before Dragonrage), cancel the animation the moment you make contact using the cancel macro, and always fly from minimum range unless you need it for movement; non-Scalecommander builds only press it with Imminent Destruction taken.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Off-global cooldown, use inside Dragonrage to instantly cast a max-rank Eternity Surge (preferred) so the empower lands quickly during burst; only use it on Fire Breath as Scalecommander, never as Flameshaper.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of the Aspects
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: This is your Bloodlust effect and is off the global cooldown; coordinate with the group and line it up with Dragonrage, and do not press it if another Bloodlust or Heroism is already planned since it applies Exhaustion.

rules.description: Opener: pot, Deep Breath, Dragonrage, empowers
rules.action: Pre-cast Living Flame, use your damage potion, then (as Scalecommander) Deep Breath into Dragonrage, Tip the Scales, Eternity Surge, and Fire Breath Rank 1 before channeling Disintegrate; this front-loads every cooldown into the first Dragonrage window.

rules.description: Tip the Scales empowers inside Dragonrage
rules.action: Save Tip the Scales for the Dragonrage window and use it on Eternity Surge for an instant max-rank cast; spending it outside of burst or on Fire Breath wastes a major damage cooldown.

Plan Fire Breath and Eternity Surge charges so at least two empower casts are ready when Dragonrage begins; you need enough empowers during the window to extend the buff with Animosity to its full duration.
Never stand idle in combat; spend Essence and Essence Burst with Disintegrate or Pyre, then fill with Living Flame and Azure Strike, using Hover to keep casting while moving.

rules.description: Keep Fire Breath DoT up, refresh at <=30%
rules.action: Maintain the Fire Breath damage-over-time debuff on the target at all times and only refresh it once it has 30% or less duration remaining so you do not waste pandemic overlap or Consume Flame fuel.

rules.description: Chain Disintegrate after the penultimate tick
rules.action: Recast Disintegrate between its second-to-last tick and the end of the channel to chain without clipping; never interrupt a Mass Disintegrate channel early as you lose buff stacks equal to the ticks clipped.

rules.description: Cast Pyre at 3+ targets with Charged Blast
rules.action: At 3 or more targets, spend Essence on Pyre once you reach about 12 stacks of Charged Blast (or at 4+ targets regardless), and avoid casting Pyre in the few seconds before Dragonrage so its three free Pyres inherit your stacks.

rules.description: Use Deep Breath from minimum range
rules.action: Always start Deep Breath at minimum range to the target and cancel the flight animation on contact with the cancel macro; gain height first when terrain is uneven so you do not get stopped mid-flight.
